base.prompt:
Create a completely new replacement Hermione Granger portrait for a visual-novel game. Her face must clearly evoke adult Emma Watson at age 23: recognizable softly arched expressive eyebrows, lively brown-hazel eyes, characteristic nose and natural lips, a fresh intelligent warm smile, delicate soft oval/heart-shaped face, gentle cheek volume and a small softly rounded chin. The user rejected the previous invented face and broad square jaws. Give her Emma Watson's natural appealing face rather than a generic fashion model face. She is an adult in an adult-entry Hogwarts AU.

Use the attached Malfoy portrait ONLY as a rendering-style reference: match its restrained cool desaturated semi-realistic photographic finish, natural eye proportions, fine believable skin texture, softly shaped light, matte wool fabric, detailed restrained dark robes. This exact same art production should have rendered both characters. Do not copy Malfoy's face, hairstyle, jewelry, green house colors, pose, or severe expression.

Hermione's NEW hair: medium chestnut-brown, neatly natural shoulder-length to upper-chest loose soft waves, simple slightly off-centre part, some hair casually tucked behind one ear, a few fine flyaways. Attractive natural texture, moderate volume, no huge bushy curls, no dense curled bangs, no salon ringlets.

A slightly lively and clever bookish expression, approachable bright eyes and a small genuine confident smile. Head mostly upright with a gentle three-quarter orientation, looking at viewer. Adult slim natural proportions. Fully clothed in white collared shirt, neat burgundy-and-gold tie, charcoal knitted V-neck sweater, simple black Gryffindor robe with subdued burgundy lining, dark pleated skirt. Holding a closed worn brown textbook naturally with both hands at the torso. No jewelry or wand required. Character composition from full head to just above knees, all hair, elbows and book inside the frame, modest breathing room above hair. Vertical 2:3, high-resolution game asset.

CRITICAL background: a genuinely clean fully transparent background outside the character. No room, no backdrop, no smoky halo, no gray haze, no vignette, no shadow floating behind her, no rectangular transparent-looking background. Clean natural hair and robe edges. Render only this one character and her book.
